title: Init Generator Schema
description: Registers the @nx-extensions/helm plugin in nx.json, so every Chart.yaml becomes a chart project. Run by `nx add @nx-extensions/helm`.

remote.description: OCI registry the chart projects push to, e.g. `oci://ghcr.io/my-org/charts`.
remote.x-prompt: OCI registry to push the charts to, e.g. oci://ghcr.io/my-org/charts (leave empty to set it later)

plainHttp.description: Use plain HTTP for an OCI registry without TLS.

appVersion.description: `project`: a chart inside another project's folder depends on that project, so releasing the project bumps the chart and sets its `appVersion` to the project's new version. Defaults to `none`.
appVersion.x-prompt: Should a chart's appVersion follow the version of the app it's in? (project: yes, none: no)

release.description: Add a `charts` release group to nx.json, so `nx release` versions the chart projects.
release.x-prompt: Add a release group, so nx release versions and publishes the charts?
